SelectRoot.description: Holds the selected value and the open state, and shares them with the parts inside it. With a `name`, or inside a FieldRoot, it renders a hidden input so the value is submitted with its form.

props.value: The selected value, or `null` for none. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the selection.
props.defaultValue: The value selected at first, when the selection isn't controlled.
props.onValueChange: Called with the new value when an item is chosen.
props.multiple: Whether any number of values may be selected. The selection is then read and written through `values`, `defaultValues` and `onValuesChange`, choosing an item toggles it, and the popup stays open.
props.values: With `multiple`: the selected values. Pass it with `onValuesChange` to control the selection.
props.defaultValues: With `multiple`: the values selected at first, when the selection isn't controlled.
props.onValuesChange: With `multiple`: called with the new list of values when an item is toggled.
props.open: Whether the popup is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the popup is open at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onOpenChange: Called after the browser or a part opened or closed the popup. A press outside and Escape can't be refused: a controlled select that keeps `open` true is shown again.
props.disabled: Whether the select is disabled: the trigger is a disabled button and can't open the popup. A disabled FieldRoot around it disables it too.
props.readOnly: Whether the popup can be opened and browsed while nothing in it can be selected.
props.required: Whether a value must be selected for the form to be valid.
props.name: The name the value is submitted under. With `multiple`, each selected value is submitted as its own entry. Inside a named FieldRoot, the field's name is used.
props.items: The label of each value, as `{ value, label }` pairs: what SelectValue shows for a value whose item hasn't rendered yet, or whose text differs from what the trigger should say.

SelectTrigger.description: The button that opens the popup, with `role="combobox"`. Its `popovertarget` makes the browser open and close the popup on a click, Enter and Space; ArrowDown and ArrowUp open it too, and typing on it while closed selects the matching item without opening.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the popup is open.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the select is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the select is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-required: Present when the select is required.
dataAttributes.data-placeholder: Present while no value is selected.

SelectValue.description: Shows the selected item's label, the labels joined by ", " with `multiple`, or the placeholder while nothing is selected.

props.placeholder: The text shown while nothing is selected.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the popup is open.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the select is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the select is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-required: Present when the select is required.
dataAttributes.data-placeholder: Present while no value is selected, so the placeholder can be styled.

SelectIcon.description: A decoration beside the value, such as a chevron. It is hidden from assistive technology.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the popup is open, for turning the icon.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the select is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the select is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-required: Present when the select is required.
dataAttributes.data-placeholder: Present while no value is selected.

SelectPopup.description: The list of options, with `role="listbox"`: an element with `popover="auto"`, placed against the trigger with CSS anchor positioning and at least as wide as it (`min-width: anchor-size(width)`). The browser closes it on Escape and on a press outside; Tab closes it too. Style it with `:popover-open` and `@starting-style`. It stays in the document while closed.

props.side: Which side of the trigger the popup sits on. The browser flips it to the other side when it doesn't fit.
props.align: Which edge of the trigger the popup lines up with.
props.sideOffset: The gap between the trigger and the popup, in pixels.
props.alignOffset: How far the popup is moved along the trigger's edge from its `align` position, in pixels.

dataAttributes.data-side: Which side of the trigger the popup is on: the one asked for until it opens, then the one the browser placed it on.

SelectItem.description: An option in the list. A click, Enter or Space chooses it; the pointer and the arrow keys move focus to it, which highlights it.

props.value: The value the item stands for: what is selected, submitted and passed to `onValueChange`.
props.label: The text that names the value, in SelectValue and for typeahead. Without it, SelectItemText's text is used, else the item's own.
props.disabled: Whether the item can't be chosen. It is skipped by the arrow keys and typeahead.

dataAttributes.data-selected: Present when the item's value is selected.
dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while the item has focus, from the pointer or the keyboard.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the item is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-label: The item's `label` prop, when it is given.

SelectItemText.description: The item's text. Use it when the item holds more than its label, such as an indicator, so SelectValue and typeahead read only the text.

SelectItemIndicator.description: Shown while its item is selected, such as a check mark. It is hidden from assistive technology.

props.keepMounted: Whether the indicator stays rendered while its item isn't selected, for drawing an empty box that `data-selected` fills.

dataAttributes.data-selected: Present when the item is selected.

SelectGroup.description: Groups related items, with `role="group"`. The group is named by its SelectGroupLabel.

SelectGroupLabel.description: The heading of a group. The group's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

SelectSeparator.description: A line between items or groups, with `role="separator"`.

SelectArrow.description: An element placed on the popup's edge that faces the trigger, centred on the trigger. It follows the popup when the browser flips it. Give it a shape in CSS and turn it per `data-side`.

dataAttributes.data-side: Which side of the trigger the popup is on. Absent while the popup is closed.
